text.ja: 村上准教授がUNESCOで開催されたLT4Allにて、「Language Sphere: A Sociotechnical Approach to Bilingual Dictionary Creation for Indigenous Languages」の講演を行いました。
text.en: Prof. Murakami gave an invited talk titled "Language Sphere: A Sociotechnical Approach to Bilingual Dictionary Creation for Indigenous Languages" in LT4All held at UNESCO.

text.ja: 西村さんと佐藤さんが情報処理学会 第85回全国大会で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Nishimura and Mr. Sato, gave a research presentation at The 85th National Convention of IPSJ.

text.ja: 大井さんが，サービスコンピューティング研究会で研究発表を行い，若手奨励賞を受賞しました．
text.en: Mr. Oi gave a research presentation at the Services Computing Workshop and received the Young Scientist Incentive Award.

text.ja: 元澤さんが，The 24th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education(AIED 2023)　のワークショップで研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Ms. Motozawa, gave a research presentation at the workshop ofthe 24th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education(AIED2023)

text.ja: 北川さんが，合同エージェントワークショップ＆シンポジウム2023で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Kitagawa gave a research presentation at Joint Agent Workshop & Symposium 2023 in Japan.

text.ja: 北川さん，松本さん，森さん，山本さんが，電子情報通信学会 総合大会で研究発表を行いました.
text.en: Mr. Kitagwa, Mr. Matsumoto, Ms. Mori and Mr. Yamamoto gave a research presentation at The General Conference of The Institute of Electronics, Information and Communication Engineers.

text.ja: 村上教授らが編集した書籍「Human-Centered Services Computing for Smart Cities」がSpringerより出版されました.
text.en: Prof. Murakami’s edited book Human-Centered Services Computing for Smart Cities has been published by Springer .

text.ja: 村上教授のモノグラフ論文「Human–Machine Collaboration for a Multilingual Service Platform」がSpringerより出版されました.
text.en: Prof. Murakami’s monograph paper Human–Machine Collaboration for a Multilingual Service Platform has been published by Springer .
